task.description:
Design and implement tests for API-11 (OpenAPI specification) and produce/update the test spec.

Required deliverables:
- tests/specs/API-11.md with explicit test cases covering requirement acceptance criteria
- Relevant test source files for /openapi.json behavior and OpenAPI generation output

Coverage expectations:
1. GET /openapi.json returns HTTP 200 without Authorization header
2. Response body is JSON with openapi version 3.1.x
3. info.version matches platform version source
4. OpenAPI output includes expected core paths and shared error/problem schemas
5. Output comes from code-generated builder path (not static fixture file)

Validation required in this handoff:
- zig build test exits 0

Update this handoff with result and artifacts_out.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-11.md exists and maps to API-11 ACs
Automated tests for /openapi.json behavior are implemented
Tests assert OpenAPI 3.1 and info.version correctness
Tests run successfully with zig build test
No regressions introduced in existing test suite

result.summary: Created API-11 test specification and implemented automated unit tests for /openapi.json behavior and generated OpenAPI output validation. Coverage includes public HTTP 200 behavior, OpenAPI 3.1.x version check, info.version source parity, core path and shared problem schema presence, and builder/serializer parity to enforce code-generated output. zig build test exits 0.
